en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued overnight, cancelled at 5:45 am
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 12:30 a.m. for isolated squally thunderstorms and cancelled it after dawn as the weather stabilised.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Thunderstorm Warning at 12:30 a.m. on Friday, later extending it until 6:30 a.m., expecting isolated squally thunderstorms over eastern and southern waters and the Islands District.
The warning was cancelled at 5:45 a.m. after the storms eased. At 7 a.m. the Observatory recorded 26 degrees Celsius with 93 per cent relative humidity under mainly cloudy conditions.

A broad trough of low pressure continues to affect the northern South China Sea and the Guangdong coast. The forecast for Friday calls for mainly cloudy skies with occasional showers and squally thunderstorms, heavier in some areas at first, and a maximum temperature around 30 degrees.

zh.headline: 天文台昨晚發出雷暴警告 今早5時45分取消
zh.dek: 天文台凌晨12時30分發出雷暴警告，其後延長至早上6時30分，預料局部地區有狂風雷暴，清晨5時45分取消。
body: 天文台於周五凌晨12時30分發出雷暴警告，其後延長至早上6時30分，預料本港東部及南部海域以至離島區有局部地區狂風雷暴。
警告於上午5時45分取消。上午7時天文台錄得氣溫26度，相對濕度百分之93，大致多雲。
一道廣闊低壓槽繼續影響南海北部及廣東沿岸。周五預測大致多雲，間中有驟雨及狂風雷暴，初時部分地區雨勢較大，日間最高氣溫約30度。
